title: Software Developers and Programmers
description: Research, design, write, modify, integrate and test computer software and applications.
karpathyRationale: Coding, debugging, and software architecture tasks are highly exposed to Large Language Models. Programmers heavily use AI co-pilots, which increases productivity but may reduce entry-level demand over time. Human supervision remains essential for system integration, security, and client requirements.

title: Web Developers and Programmers
description: Build, design, and maintain websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other web frameworks.
karpathyRationale: Front-end code generation, component design, and UI templates are extremely well-handled by generative AI tools, making this role highly exposed to automation.

title: Data Scientists and Statisticians
description: Develop mathematical models, analyze data, and build machine learning algorithms to solve business problems.
karpathyRationale: While AI is excellent at writing boilerplate statistical code, cleaning datasets, and suggesting models, the core data science tasks of business translation, validation, and advanced math modeling require high-level logical reasoning.

title: Computer and Information Systems Managers
description: Plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate the operations of information systems and electronic data processing departments.
karpathyRationale: IT management involves high levels of human coordination, strategic budgeting, security audit supervision, and hiring. While AI assists in reports and analytics, leadership and human management protect this role from automation.

title: Financial Auditors and Accountants
description: Examine and analyze the financial records of organizations to ensure accuracy, compliance, and tax efficiency.
karpathyRationale: Accounting rules, spreadsheets, and tax preparation are highly structured and exposed to AI. However, financial auditing requires professional skepticism, regulatory accountability, and ethical judgments that AI cannot legally assume.

title: Financial and Investment Analysts
description: Conduct research, analyze financial statements, and provide investment advice or credit analysis.
karpathyRationale: Financial report parsing, valuation modeling, and market research are easily augmented by LLMs. However, investor relations, risk appetite assessment, and portfolio customization retain a strong human element.

title: Financial Managers
description: Plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate the operations of financial and accounting departments.
karpathyRationale: Capital budgeting decisions, corporate strategy, M&A negotiation, and high-level stakeholder management require trust, reputation, and strategic vision that cannot be automated.

title: Professional Occupations in Advertising, Marketing and PR
description: Assess public relations needs, draft copy, formulate marketing plans, and coordinate advertising campaigns.
karpathyRationale: Copywriting, email campaigns, basic SEO analysis, and social media scheduling are heavily impacted by generative AI. Creative direction, brand messaging, and human empathy are still critical to stand out.

title: Human Resources Professionals
description: Recruit personnel, coordinate training, administer benefits, and assist in employee relations and policies.
karpathyRationale: Resume filtering and policy drafting are highly exposed to AI. However, resolving conflicts, interviewing, culture-building, and union relations require emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills.

title: Registered Nurses and Registered Psychiatric Nurses
description: Provide direct nursing care to patients, deliver health education programs, and consult on patient issues.
karpathyRationale: Nursing is highly tactile, requiring physical administration of medications, wound dressing, patient transfers, and immediate physical response. It also requires massive emotional labor, patient reassurance, and clinical empathy.

title: General Practitioners and Family Physicians
description: Diagnose and treat the diseases, physiological disorders and injuries of patients.
karpathyRationale: AI can assist in diagnostic matching and parsing patient history. However, physical diagnosis, complex patient interaction, shared decision making, and legal liability for human lives remain firmly human.

title: Electrical and Electronics Engineers
description: Design, plan, research, evaluate and test electrical and electronic equipment and systems.
karpathyRationale: AI accelerates circuit design, schematic generation, and simulations. However, physical hardware integration, laboratory testing, power grid management, and safety sign-off require human engineers.

title: Mechanical Engineers
description: Design and develop machinery, thermal devices, manufacturing systems, and heating/cooling systems.
karpathyRationale: CAD modeling, finite element analysis, and material selection are highly assisted by AI. Real-world factory testing, physical troubleshooting, and safety compliance require human mechanical engineers.

title: Civil Engineers
description: Plan, design, develop and manage projects for the construction or repair of buildings, earth structures, powerhouses, roads, and bridges.
karpathyRationale: Structural analysis is software-driven. However, site inspections, environmental risk negotiations, public safety responsibility, and regulatory approvals require a licensed Professional Engineer (P.Eng).

title: Psychologists
description: Assess and diagnose behavioural, cognitive, emotional and cognitive disorders, and offer counseling and therapy.
karpathyRationale: AI therapy bots exist but cannot substitute for deep therapeutic alliance, nuance of human suffering, clinical empathy, crisis management, and legal requirements for diagnosing mental health conditions.

title: Social Workers
description: Help individuals, families and groups resolve social and personal problems and advocate for social justice.
karpathyRationale: Social work requires deep community knowledge, navigation of complex welfare and family dynamics, emergency home visits, and human-to-human empathy, making it highly automated-resistant.

title: Graphic Designers and Illustrators
description: Create layouts and designs for print, web, and advertising, and produce animations and illustrations.
karpathyRationale: Generative image models (Midjourney, DALL-E) and AI vector layout tools can instantly create concepts, drawings, and layouts. The role is shifting rapidly to AI prompting and editing, which reduces total design workforce requirements.

title: Secondary School Teachers
description: Prepare and teach academic, technical, vocational or specialized subjects in public or private secondary schools.
karpathyRationale: AI can assist in grading, lesson plan generation, and creating quizzes. However, classroom management, student mentoring, emotional encouragement, and resolving behavioral issues require real human teachers.

title: Elementary School and Kindergarten Teachers
description: Teach basic subjects and coordinate developmental activities in public or private elementary schools.
karpathyRationale: Early childhood teaching is highly physical, social, and emotional. Developing social skills and coordinating play-based learning cannot be done by software.

title: Lawyers and Quebec Notaries
description: Provide legal advice, draft agreements, represent clients before courts, and conduct legal research.
karpathyRationale: Legal research, contract analysis, and boilerplate drafting are highly exposed to LLMs. However, advocacy in court, strategic client advice, mediation, and representing high-stakes human disputes require human attorneys.

title: Natural and Applied Science Policy Researchers and Advisors
description: Conduct research and advise on policy, regulation, and programs in environmental science, health, and technology fields.
karpathyRationale: Report writing and comparative regulatory analysis are highly exposed to AI tools. Stakeholder consultations, consensus building, and political negotiation remain human-led.

title: Biologists and Related Scientists
description: Conduct research, study biological processes, and manage environmental or laboratory programs.
karpathyRationale: AI aids in genomic analysis, protein folding, and documentation. However, physical laboratory work, field sample collection, and experimental validation require human scientists.
